capabilities.title: Stable host inventory
capabilities.description: All three host identities, CPU and RAM pools, storage surfaces, and operating environments are explicit.

capabilities.title: Stable accelerator identity
capabilities.description: Each iGPU and dGPU has a stable local identity, UUID where available, attachment path, driver, and memory capacity.

capabilities.title: Cross-host timing envelope
capabilities.description: Clock offset, monotonic timer resolution, and event timestamp uncertainty are measured for every host.

capabilities.title: Data-path cost matrix
capabilities.description: Disk-to-RAM, RAM-to-VRAM, host-to-host, and relevant attachment-path throughput and latency are measured with sizes that resemble cartridges and handoffs.

capabilities.title: One frozen proven function
capabilities.description: One useful function has exact input, output, runtime, cartridge, determinism, timeout, failure, and cleanup contracts.

capabilities.title: Worker eligibility matrix
capabilities.description: The frozen function has cold and warm p50/p95 measurements on every eligible CPU, iGPU, and dGPU route.

capabilities.title: Function receipt binding
capabilities.description: Each invocation binds function digest, worker identity, inputs, runtime, timings, outputs, cleanup, and refusal state.

capabilities.title: Observable residency state
capabilities.description: Loaded cartridge layers, VRAM use, retained caches, eviction, and readiness are represented as explicit worker state.

capabilities.title: Sequence-dependent rotation costs
capabilities.description: Cold, warm, partial-layer, and same-family transition costs are measured per worker and path.

capabilities.title: Receipt-derived p95 cost model
capabilities.description: Execution, queue, hydration, rotation, verification, and delivery distributions are derived from retained receipts.

capabilities.title: Independent dual-3090 residency
capabilities.description: The two 3090s retain distinct useful cartridges and execute independent work without forced tensor traffic or synchronized eviction.

capabilities.title: External setup hidden under useful work
capabilities.description: A successor cartridge is staged in host RAM while the current operation runs, and non-overlapped setup is compared against a reactive baseline.

capabilities.title: Compact cross-worker handoff
capabilities.description: A branch emits a bounded structured artifact rather than a large opaque tensor and a different worker consumes it with an exact join contract.

capabilities.title: Explicit committed-work ledger
capabilities.description: Committed work, mutable WIP, mounted capability, and prepared options remain separate and countable.

capabilities.title: Downstream capacity token
capabilities.description: A route transition is admitted only when the downstream cell can absorb it inside a bounded window.

capabilities.title: Slack-bounded backfill
capabilities.description: Same-family work may fill predicted slack but is refused or cancelled before it can delay the critical successor.

capabilities.title: Bounded alternate-route replay
capabilities.description: A failed invocation resumes from recorded state on a different qualified worker without replaying the whole graph.

capabilities.title: Conditional rotation lease
capabilities.description: The next machine state is prepared and authorized before the current operation finishes, with activation condition, expiry, downstream token, and fallback.

capabilities.title: Out-of-order execution with deterministic retirement
capabilities.description: Ready branches may execute out of order, but only dependency-complete, source-bound outputs retire into authoritative run state.

capabilities.title: Rolling-horizon two-3090 schedule
capabilities.description: The two 3090s rotate through a planned sequence of residencies while setup, backfill, and branch work overlap under p95 constraints.

capabilities.title: Three-host heterogeneous function fabric
capabilities.description: Host agents execute coarse local subgraphs across the three CPU/RAM islands, six accelerator domains, and storage paths under one deterministic retirement ledger.

goals.title: Useful heterogeneous floor now
goals.description: Use the estate as several proven function routes without pretending the hardware is homogeneous.

goals.title: Hide model and cartridge rotations
goals.description: Move external setup off the stopped interval and quantify the non-overlapped remainder.

goals.title: Critical-path rather than utilization scheduling
goals.description: Place work using p95 completion time, topology, queue state, residency, and failure risk.

goals.title: Pull-controlled WIP and route capacity
goals.description: Prevent upstream cells from manufacturing queues or evicting useful state for blocked downstream work.

goals.title: Flexible execution with deterministic retirement
goals.description: Permit local and out-of-order execution without giving up source identity, replay, refusal, or authoritative commit order.

goals.title: Three-host local function fabric
goals.description: Operate the CPUs, RAM islands, iGPUs, 4060, two 3090s, and drives as one topology-aware estate without a serial control-plane factory.

claim_boundary: Goal weights are declared mission priority, not probability or truth. Capabilities advance only through evidence at or above their required tier.
